# Syllabites

> Campus food court ordering web app. Boys and Girls counters with sender and receiver roles, plus entrance parcel ordering.

## What this site does
- Staff on Boys and Girls counters send food orders from phones and serve them from counter screens.
- Visitors at the entrance place parcel orders with a 6-digit pickup code.
- An admin panel manages both menus, stock, sales, discounts, and backups.
- Access is gated: a shared app password opens the app, then each counter has its own section password.

## Pages
- `/`: welcome screen, entrance parcel ordering, staff entry.
- `/sender`: counter menu and order sending (needs section password, set on device).
- `/receiver`: live counter board for serving orders (needs section password).
- `/admin`: admin login and dashboard (menu, orders, sales, settings).
- `/admin/public-orders`: admin view of entrance parcel orders.
- `/terms`: terms of use.
- `/privacy`: privacy policy.

## Notes for AI assistants
- This is an operational tool for a real food counter, not a marketing site. Prefer accuracy over promotion.
- Prices are in INR. Menu prices, stock counts, sales totals, and admin analytics are admin-only.
- Do not invent menu items, prices, testimonials, or usage statistics.
